title: Condition-style sales master data
summary: Validity-based commercial records that price, substitute, allow, exclude, reward, or recommend products.

entities.title: Pricing Condition Record
entities.memory_hook: The record stores the number. The pricing configuration decides whether SAP ever looks at it.
entities.business_question: Which commercial value is valid for this key combination, date, quantity and unit context?
entities.scope: Pricing condition records hold values such as prices, discounts and surcharges. They are master data. Pricing procedure, condition types, access sequences, requirements and formulas are configuration/logic around those records.
key_dimensions: sales area and relevant customer/product attributes

high_value_attributes.name: condition amount/rate
high_value_attributes.why: The commercial value itself.

high_value_attributes.name: validity
high_value_attributes.why: A perfectly maintained record outside the pricing date is still invisible.

high_value_attributes.name: key combination
high_value_attributes.why: Determines how specific the record is and whether the access can match it.

high_value_attributes.name: scales
high_value_attributes.why: Can change value by quantity/value thresholds.

high_value_attributes.name: currency / pricing unit / UoM
high_value_attributes.why: Prevents a numeric value from being interpreted in the wrong commercial unit.

precedence: First prove pricing procedure, then condition type, then access sequence, then access key, then validity and scales.
A more specific record only wins if the access sequence searches it before a generic fallback.
Do not confuse the maintained condition record with transactional pricing result storage in the document.

modern: Manage Prices - Sales / condition record apps depending on deployment
maintenance.note: Classic transactions are strong diagnostic references in private-cloud/on-premise systems.

notes: Do not use PRCD_ELEMENTS as the mental model for the master record; it represents transactional price elements in S/4HANA documents.

failure_signals: condition record exists but is not found
wrong price only for one customer/product combination
order and invoice differ because billing reprices
lead_questions: Which access actually found the record?
What is the pricing date and record validity?
Is the issue the record, the search configuration, or copy-control repricing?

relations.why: customer attributes often form pricing keys
product attributes often form pricing keys
pricing consumes condition records after procedure/access logic is known

entities.title: Material Determination Record
entities.memory_hook: The material the user typed is not necessarily the material SAP keeps.
entities.business_question: Should the requested product be substituted with another product for this customer/context and validity period?
entities.scope: Material determination uses condition technique to find substitution records. It can support discontinued products, promotional packaging and automatic product selection scenarios.
key_dimensions: customer or partner attributes where configured

high_value_attributes.name: substitute material(s)
high_value_attributes.why: Defines the product candidates that can replace the requested material.

high_value_attributes.name: validity
high_value_attributes.why: Controls when the substitution relationship applies.

high_value_attributes.name: substitution reason
high_value_attributes.why: Controls substitution behavior and can change how replacement is processed.

high_value_attributes.name: sequence / additional substitutes
high_value_attributes.why: Allows several alternatives and supports more complex automatic product selection.

writes_or_influences: pricing/product texts for the resulting item
precedence: Condition technique decides which substitution record is found.
After substitution, debug downstream item/pricing/ATP behavior against the resulting product, not only the originally entered product.
Automatic product selection and simple substitution are related but not identical runtime behaviors.

maintenance.note: VB11 is documented as an app/transaction reference for creating records.

tables: condition-table-dependent storage; use released CDS/API where available

failure_signals: substitute found for one customer but not another
lead_questions: What product exists in the document after determination?
Did the product change alter item category, plant, ATP or price?

relations.why: requested and substitute products are part of the condition record
substitution can change the product whose item-category group is read
the resulting product changes the availability object

entities.title: Material Listing / Exclusion Record
entities.memory_hook: Before pricing a product, Sales may first decide that the customer is not allowed to buy it.
entities.business_question: Is this customer allowed to order this product in the current listing/exclusion context?
entities.scope: Listing and exclusion are condition-record-based controls over which materials a customer may or may not buy. In standard customer/material scenarios, partner context can include sold-to and payer.

high_value_attributes.name: listing versus exclusion
high_value_attributes.why: One constrains the permitted set; the other explicitly blocks a product.

high_value_attributes.name: customer / partner key
high_value_attributes.why: Sold-to and payer context can produce different results.

high_value_attributes.name: validity
high_value_attributes.why: The restriction is time dependent.

high_value_attributes.name: material set
high_value_attributes.why: Defines the permitted or prohibited commercial assortment for the matched record.

precedence: Standard behavior uses condition technique; prove the actual partner/key combination before changing records.
A listing means the customer can only buy listed products when the relevant listing record applies.
Exclusion is a direct prohibition for the matched product/context.

modern: Manage Material Listing/Exclusion Records depending on deployment
maintenance.note: SAP documents VB01 as a creation reference in on-premise contexts.

failure_signals: material rejected before price/ATP investigation matters
same product allowed for one customer but blocked for another
sold-to and payer produce surprising eligibility
lead_questions: Is this a listing failure or exclusion hit?
Does the validity date cover the document?

relations.why: customer/partner is part of the restriction key

entities.title: Free Goods Condition Record
entities.memory_hook: Free goods are not a manual zero price; they are a quantity rule with a commercial contract behind it.
entities.business_question: For this customer/product context and quantity, should SAP add or calculate a free quantity?
entities.scope: Free-goods agreements are maintained in condition-style master data and evaluated during sales-order processing. Standard concepts include inclusive and exclusive bonus quantities.

high_value_attributes.name: minimum quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Defines when the agreement starts to apply.

high_value_attributes.name: free-goods quantity / base quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Defines the commercial ratio.

high_value_attributes.name: calculation rule
high_value_attributes.why: Controls how free quantity is calculated.

high_value_attributes.name: inclusive versus exclusive
high_value_attributes.why: Changes whether the free amount sits inside the requested quantity or is added as an extra item/quantity.

precedence: The agreement must match the condition key and validity before quantity logic matters.
Inclusive and exclusive free goods have different quantity semantics; do not reduce both to 'zero price'.
Item-category/configuration context still controls the operational behavior of resulting items.

modern: free-goods condition maintenance apps depending on deployment
maintenance.note: Free-goods agreements are condition-style master data. Maintenance UX and technical entry points vary by deployment; validate the target release before using a legacy transaction reference.

failure_signals: free item not created at expected threshold
free goods appear in order but downstream delivery behavior surprises users
lead_questions: Which agreement matched and on what key?
Is the rule inclusive or exclusive?
What item category does the free-goods item receive downstream?

relations.why: customer context can be part of free-goods key
ordered/free product context is part of the agreement
free-goods subitems need item behavior after they are created

entities.title: Cross-Selling Assignment Data
entities.memory_hook: Cross-selling is a recommendation relationship, not a product substitution.
entities.business_question: Which additional products should Sales suggest when this product is ordered?
entities.scope: Classic ERP cross-selling links an ordered product to one or more suggested products and uses cross-selling profile/condition-technique context to control runtime proposal behavior.

high_value_attributes.name: main-to-suggested-product relationship
high_value_attributes.why: Defines which complementary product candidates are proposed.

high_value_attributes.name: profile / runtime presentation context
high_value_attributes.why: Controls how the relationship is surfaced during order entry.

high_value_attributes.name: relevance of suggested products
high_value_attributes.why: Cross-selling only helps if recommendations remain commercially meaningful and available.

consumed_by: cross-selling proposal during sales order entry
precedence: Cross-selling proposes an additional product; material determination replaces/substitutes a requested product. Keep those concepts separate.
Proposal data does not force an item into the document; user/process behavior can still decide whether it is added.
Do not conflate classic S/4HANA/ERP cross-selling with AI recommendation capabilities in a separate CRM/Sales Cloud layer.

maintenance.note: Classic ERP cross-selling is a maintained product relationship driven by condition technique/profile logic. Exact maintenance entry points should be validated for the target deployment.

notes: Exact legacy table references are intentionally omitted until target-release validation; the graph models the business relationship rather than pretending a storage table is universal.

failure_signals: proposal works in one sales context but not another
lead_questions: Is the problem the relationship, proposal logic, or availability/relevance of the suggested product?

relations.why: main and suggested products form the relationship
